mapper.sql: case when dr.execution_status is not null and dr.execution_status != '' then lower(dr.execution_status) when eo.status is not null and eo.status != '' then lower(eo.status) when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'FILLED' then 'filled' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' then 'partial' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'CANCELED' then 'canceled' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'EXPIRED' then 'expired' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'REJECTED' then 'failed' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'BLOCKED' then 'blocked' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'SKIPPED' then 'skipped' when coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) = 'SUBMITTED' then 'submitted' else 'pending' end

case when status is not null and status != '' then lower(status) when order_status = 'FILLED' then 'filled' when order_status = 'PARTIALLY_FILLED' then 'partial' when order_status = 'CANCELED' then 'canceled' when order_status = 'EXPIRED' then 'expired' when order_status = 'REJECTED' then 'failed' when order_status = 'BLOCKED' then 'blocked' when order_status = 'SKIPPED' then 'skipped' when order_status = 'SUBMITTED' then 'submitted' else 'pending' end
case lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) end

coalesce( eo.action, case when pcl.change_type = 'CLOSE' then 'CLOSE' when pcl.change_type = 'REDUCE' then 'REDUCE' when pcl.change_type = 'OPEN' and = 'short' then 'OPEN_SHORT' when pcl.change_type = 'OPEN' then 'OPEN_LONG' when pcl.change_type = 'ADD' and = 'short' then 'ADD_SHORT' when pcl.change_type = 'ADD' then 'ADD_LONG' else null end )
mapper.select: select count(1) from event_raw
select count(1) from signal_event
select count(1) from decision_run
select count(1) from risk_guard_hit

select count(1) from position_snapshot ps inner join ( select max(id) as latestId from position_snapshot group by exchange_code, symbol, case lower(side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(side) end ) latest on latest.latestId = ps.id where ps.position_quantity > 0

select coalesce(sum(ps.unrealized_pnl), 0) from position_snapshot ps inner join ( select max(id) as latestId from position_snapshot group by exchange_code, symbol, case lower(side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(side) end ) latest on latest.latestId = ps.id where ps.position_quantity > 0

select id, trace_id as traceId, mode, account_equity as accountEquity, unrealized_pnl as unrealizedPnl, realized_pnl as realizedPnl, daily_pnl as dailyPnl, max_drawdown_pct as maxDrawdownPct, peak_account_equity as peakAccountEquity, created_at as createdAt from pnl_snapshot order by id desc limit 1

select dr.id, dr.trace_id as traceId, dr.symbol, dr.mode, dr.action, dr.confidence, dr.summary_reason as summaryReason, dr.model_code as modelCode, dr.model_provider as modelProvider, dr.trigger_reason as triggerReason, dr.trigger_source as triggerSource, dr.dispatch_mode as dispatchMode, dr.selected_agents_json as selectedAgentsJson, dr.combination_match_json as combinationMatchJson, dr.active_signal_refs_json as activeSignalRefsJson, dr.cooldown_blocked as cooldownBlocked, dr.budget_blocked as budgetBlocked, as executionStatus, coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) as orderStatus, dr.created_at as createdAt from decision_run dr left join exchange_order eo on eo.id = ( select max(inner_eo.id) from exchange_order inner_eo where inner_eo.trace_id = dr.trace_id ) order by dr.id desc limit 1
select id, trace_id as traceId, event_type as eventType, symbol, exchange_code as exchangeCode, payload_json as payloadJson, created_at as createdAt from event_raw order by id desc limit #{limit}
select id, trace_id as traceId, symbol, signal_type as signalType, feature_json as featureJson, created_at as createdAt from signal_event order by id desc limit #{limit}

select id, trace_id as traceId, symbol, window_key as windowKey, source_type as sourceType, signal_type as signalType, direction, strength_score as strengthScore, decay_score as decayScore, opened_at as openedAt, expires_at as expiresAt, last_event_at as lastEventAt, last_confirmed_at as lastConfirmedAt, dedupe_key as dedupeKey, combine_until_at as combineUntilAt, is_active as active, state_json as stateJson, created_at as createdAt from signal_window_state where is_active = 1 and (expires_at is null or expires_at >= #{currentTime}) order by coalesce(last_event_at, created_at) desc, id desc limit #{limit}
select id, trace_id as traceId, agent_name as agentName, bias, confidence, reason, created_at as createdAt from agent_conclusion order by id desc limit #{limit}

select dr.id, dr.trace_id as traceId, dr.symbol, dr.mode, dr.action, dr.confidence, dr.summary_reason as summaryReason, dr.model_code as modelCode, dr.model_provider as modelProvider, as executionStatus, coalesce(dr.order_status, eo.order_status) as orderStatus, dr.created_at as createdAt from decision_run dr left join exchange_order eo on eo.id = ( select max(inner_eo.id) from exchange_order inner_eo where inner_eo.trace_id = dr.trace_id ) order by id desc limit #{limit}
select id, trace_id as traceId, rule_code as ruleCode, reason, created_at as createdAt from risk_guard_hit order by id desc limit #{limit}

select id, trace_id as traceId, exchange_code as exchangeCode, symbol, side, position_side as positionSide, order_ref as orderRef, trade_id as tradeId, fill_price as fillPrice, fill_quantity as fillQuantity, fee, fee_ccy as feeCcy, is_maker as isMaker, exec_type as execType, realized_pnl as realizedPnl, filled_at as filledAt, raw_payload as rawPayload, created_at as createdAt from exchange_fill order by id desc limit #{limit}

select eo.trace_id as traceId, eo.exchange_code as exchangeCode, eo.symbol, eo.mode, as action, eo.side, as positionSide, eo.order_ref as orderRef, pcl.change_type as changeType, ef.fill_price as fillPrice, ef.fill_quantity as fillQuantity, case when in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') then prev.entry_price when in ('OPEN_LONG', 'OPEN_SHORT', 'ADD_LONG', 'ADD_SHORT') then ef.fill_price else null end as openPrice, case when in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') then ef.fill_price else null end as closePrice, ps.entry_price as entryPrice, ps.position_quantity as positionQuantity, case when in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') and prev.entry_price is not null and ef.fill_price is not null and pcl.before_quantity is not null and pcl.after_quantity is not null then round( ( case when = 'short' then prev.entry_price - ef.fill_price else ef.fill_price - prev.entry_price end ) * ( case when pcl.before_quantity > pcl.after_quantity then pcl.before_quantity - pcl.after_quantity else 0 end ), 8 ) else 0 end as realizedPnl, as executionStatus, eo.order_status as orderStatus, coalesce(ef.created_at, eo.created_at) as createdAt from exchange_order eo left join exchange_fill ef on ef.id = ( select max(inner_ef.id) from exchange_fill inner_ef where inner_ef.trace_id = eo.trace_id and inner_ef.order_ref = eo.order_ref ) left join position_snapshot ps on ps.id = ( select max(inner_ps.id) from position_snapshot inner_ps where inner_ps.trace_id = eo.trace_id ) left join position_change_log pcl on pcl.id = ( select max(inner_pcl.id) from position_change_log inner_pcl where inner_pcl.trace_id = eo.trace_id ) left join position_snapshot prev on prev.id = ( select max(inner_prev.id) from position_snapshot inner_prev where inner_prev.exchange_code = coalesce(ps.exchange_code, eo.exchange_code) and inner_prev.symbol = coalesce(ps.symbol, eo.symbol) and case lower(inner_prev.side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(inner_prev.side) end = case lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(coalesce(ps.side, eo.position_side, eo.side)) end and (ps.id is null or inner_prev.id < ps.id) ) where ef.id is not null order by coalesce(ef.created_at, eo.created_at) desc, eo.id desc limit #{limit}

select eo.trace_id as traceId, eo.exchange_code as exchangeCode, eo.symbol, eo.mode, as action, eo.side, as positionSide, eo.order_ref as orderRef, pcl.change_type as changeType, ef.fill_price as fillPrice, ef.fill_quantity as fillQuantity, case when in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') then prev.entry_price when in ('OPEN_LONG', 'OPEN_SHORT', 'ADD_LONG', 'ADD_SHORT') then ef.fill_price else null end as openPrice, case when in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') then ef.fill_price else null end as closePrice, ps.entry_price as entryPrice, ps.position_quantity as positionQuantity, case when in ('CLOSE', 'REDUCE') and prev.entry_price is not null and ef.fill_price is not null and pcl.before_quantity is not null and pcl.after_quantity is not null then round( ( case when = 'short' then prev.entry_price - ef.fill_price else ef.fill_price - prev.entry_price end ) * ( case when pcl.before_quantity > pcl.after_quantity then pcl.before_quantity - pcl.after_quantity else 0 end ), 8 ) else 0 end as realizedPnl, as executionStatus, eo.order_status as orderStatus, coalesce(ef.created_at, eo.created_at) as createdAt from exchange_order eo left join exchange_fill ef on ef.id = ( select max(inner_ef.id) from exchange_fill inner_ef where inner_ef.trace_id = eo.trace_id and inner_ef.order_ref = eo.order_ref ) left join position_snapshot ps on ps.id = ( select max(inner_ps.id) from position_snapshot inner_ps where inner_ps.trace_id = eo.trace_id ) left join position_change_log pcl on pcl.id = ( select max(inner_pcl.id) from position_change_log inner_pcl where inner_pcl.trace_id = eo.trace_id ) left join position_snapshot prev on prev.id = ( select max(inner_prev.id) from position_snapshot inner_prev where inner_prev.exchange_code = coalesce(ps.exchange_code, eo.exchange_code) and inner_prev.symbol = coalesce(ps.symbol, eo.symbol) and case lower(inner_prev.side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(inner_prev.side) end = and (ps.id is null or inner_prev.id < ps.id) ) where ef.id is not null and coalesce(ef.created_at, eo.created_at) > #{createdAt} order by coalesce(ef.created_at, eo.created_at) asc, eo.id asc

select id, trace_id as traceId, exchange_code as exchangeCode, symbol, side, mode, order_ref as orderRef, client_order_id as clientOrderId, action, order_type as orderType, position_side as positionSide, reduce_only as reduceOnly, td_mode as tdMode, leverage, limit_price as limitPrice, quantity_base as quantityBase, okx_enhanced_execution as okxEnhancedExecution, filled_quantity as filledQuantity, avg_fill_price as avgFillPrice, fee, fee_ccy as feeCcy, post_only as postOnly, as status, as executionStatus, order_status as orderStatus, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt, filled_at as filledAt, raw_payload as rawPayload from exchange_order order by id desc limit #{limit}

select ps.id, ps.exchange_code as exchangeCode, ps.symbol, case lower(ps.side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(ps.side) end as side, ps.position_quantity as positionQuantity, ps.entry_price as entryPrice, ps.unrealized_pnl as unrealizedPnl, ps.created_at as createdAt from position_snapshot ps inner join ( select max(id) as latestId from position_snapshot group by exchange_code, symbol, case lower(side) when 'buy' then 'long' when 'sell' then 'short' else lower(side) end ) latest on latest.latestId = ps.id where ps.position_quantity > 0 order by ps.created_at desc, ps.id desc limit #{limit}
select as "executionStatus", count(*) as "total" from exchange_order group by
select count(1) from decision_run where cooldown_blocked = 1
